//ClientIds: The client IDs this API pins in its authorization rules. Each must equal the same key under ClientIds in src/IDP/appsettings.json (where the IDP registers the client); a missing one stops the start-up.
//Mfa: Step-up: resending a parked Outbox message needs a sign-in with the authenticator code while true. Keep it equal to the IDP's Mfa:Enabled (ps\Toggle-MFA.ps1 switches all places).

Mfa.//StepUpMaxAgeMinutes: While MFA is on, a resend needs a sign-in with the authenticator code at most this many minutes old (1-60).

//DigitalGold: Alerts: readiness turns Degraded when a purchase waits longer than this in one step - SENT without the Partner Bank's answer or PAID without the payment advice delivered after HandoverMinutes, ORDERED without a payment after UnpaidOrderMinutes (more than 35: the Worker cancels such orders within 35), ORDERED with a payment that is not final after PaymentDecisionMinutes; a problem for a person always. Required, positive.
//Kafka: The Outbox relay publishes partner-products.digital-gold.events as the API's own Kafka user (write on that topic only, Setup-KafkaSecurity.ps1).
//PartnerBank: EWP as the Partner Bank's distributor: its token endpoint and API on their mutual-TLS ports, EWP's client ID there, and EWP's keys - made by ps\pki\New-EwpLocalPki.ps1 in %USERPROFILE%\.ewp-pki, outside the repository. Outside Development: PermittedHosts lists the Partner Bank's host names.

PartnerBank.//Settlement: The Partner Bank's account that receives the Digital Gold purchases' payments (the payee of every purchase's payment; never typed at the counter).
